rv.q: Short's manic energy and dead-on impressions keep the audience in stitches, even when the material feels thin.
Short nonetheless delivers a good time.
This is an uneven, mostly good-natured, handsomely produced evening that saves its freshest material for late in the nonstop 105-minute show.
But, bless his heart, he has yet to find a show that lets him shine as he was meant to.
As an over the top musical revue that is little more than a slap in the face at celebrities taking themselves too seriously the evening is a laugh filled riot.
